KARAOKE.OpenManagerHint: Choose playlist tracks, set fonts and lyric placement, and import or export JSON.
KARAOKE.NoPlaylists: No playlists in this world yet.
KARAOKE.SurroundingHint: Current line always shows. Uncheck these to hide the dimmed lines above or below it.
KARAOKE.DualLanguageEnable: Show a smaller secondary line above the main lyrics
KARAOKE.DualLanguageHint: Store as many languages as you need in JSON. Main is large; secondary is smaller on top. Players can swap them from the on-table language bar.
KARAOKE.ShowSecondary: Show secondary language as small text on top
KARAOKE.ShowSecondaryHint: Hide the smaller top line on this client.
KARAOKE.LanguageHint: Main is the large line. Secondary sits above it in a smaller font. Each player can change this during playback.
KARAOKE.ShowLangBar: Show expanded language bar on the table
KARAOKE.ShowLangBarHint: When karaoke is playing, show the full Main / Secondary dropdowns. If off, a small draggable language icon is used instead. Minimize with −, drag the grip or icon to move it.
KARAOKE.OpenLangBar: Language options — click to expand, drag to move
KARAOKE.ShowReferenceLine: Show secondary language (small top line) on this client
KARAOKE.ShowPreviousLine: Show previous line on this client
KARAOKE.ShowNextLine: Show next line on this client
KARAOKE.StageHint: Drag the sample lyric to place it. This matches the table overlay.
KARAOKE.LrcHint: Add one LRC block per language. Pair lines with the same timestamps, for example [00:12.40] in Traditional Chinese and Japanese. JSON export stores every language under languages and cues.texts.
KARAOKE.HideOverlay: Hide karaoke overlay on this client
KARAOKE.Previewing: Showing a placement preview on the table.
KARAOKE.ImportedTrack: Imported karaoke data onto this track.
KARAOKE.ImportNone: No matching playlist tracks were found for that JSON.
KARAOKE.ImportInvalid: That file is not a Foundry Karaoke JSON pack.
KARAOKE.NeedGM: Only a GM can edit karaoke data.
KARAOKE.MissingSound: That playlist sound no longer exists.
